symptom: Devices in the intended VLAN cannot communicate across two switches.
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk indicates that the inter-switch link is not operating as a trunk.

expected_output.root_cause: Inter-switch link is not configured as a trunk
expected_output.evidence: The link between the switches is not operating as a trunk, so the required VLAN traffic cannot cross the link.
fix_steps: Identify the interface connecting the two switches.
Configure the interface as a trunk.
Verify the trunk using show interfaces trunk.
